import zipfile, re
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

NS = {"m": "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main"}
z = zipfile.ZipFile("budget.xlsx")

def parse_sheet(xml_bytes):
    root = ET.fromstring(xml_bytes)
    cells = {}
    for c in root.iter("{%s}c" % NS["m"]):
        ref = (c.get("r") or "").strip()
        v = c.find("m:v", NS)
        raw = v.text if (v is not None and v.text is not None) else None
        if raw is not None:
            try:
                cells[ref] = int(raw) if re.fullmatch(r"-?\d+", raw) else float(raw)
            except ValueError:
                cells[ref] = raw
    return cells

cells = parse_sheet(z.read("xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml"))

expense_rows = list(range(11, 23))  # C11:C22
total = 0
print("Expense items:")
for r in expense_rows:
    ref = f"C{r}"
    val = cells.get(ref)
    print(f"  {ref}: {val}")
    total += val

print(f"\nTotal expenses (C11:C22) = {total}")
print(f"Expected per workbook formula SUM(C11:C22) = {sum(cells.get(f'C{r}', 0) for r in expense_rows)}")
